title: New York General Business Law section 396-b, synthetic performers in advertisements

sources.title: New York General Business Law section 396-b, Advertisements, on the New York State Senate's site
Senate Bill S8420-A (2025), signed 11 December 2025 as Chapter 617 of the Laws of 2025

rules.title: Disclose a synthetic performer in your ad
rules.summary: If you produce an advertisement for New York featuring an AI-generated person who looks human but is not an identifiable real person, and you know it, disclose conspicuously in the ad that a synthetic performer is in it. Audio ads, AI used only to translate a human performer, and promotions of expressive works that use the performer the same way are exempt. $1,000 for a first violation, $5,000 after.
rules.quote: shall conspicuously disclose in such advertisement that a synthetic performer is in such advertisement
